Advances: ancora.gate

Investigation ticket per the same-seed flake protocol: signature crossed the 2-acceptance cap (4 sightings). Full details in first comment.

comments.text:
Signature: Mix.Tasks.Spec.CheckTest, "json mode includes a growth finding before the last-line verdict", test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs:69 — Jason.DecodeError, unexpected byte 0x57 ("W") at position 0 of the first captured stdout line.

Evidence:
- Sightings 1-2 (2026-08-31): delta test-critic run and rebase worker full-suite runs; accepted under the flake protocol.
- Sightings 3-4 (2026-09-01): two consecutive full-suite runs in a fresh worktree at 8f370c5, both red on this test only (321 tests + 3 properties otherwise green). The file in isolation is green (11 tests). Never red at an actual merge gate so far.

Deliverable:
Root-cause the interleaving and fix it. The repro is concurrency-dependent: a line starting with "W" (a warning) lands on captured stdout before the JSON report only when the full suite runs async. Two hypotheses to rule in or out: (a) the spec.check subprocess itself writes a warning to stdout ahead of the JSON report in JSON mode — a product defect against the single-stdout-writer contract (warnings belong on stderr in JSON mode); (b) the test's capture picks up output from a sibling async test. If (a), fix the output layer; if (b), fix the test's capture/isolation. Deleting or weakening the first-line-is-JSON assertion is not a fix.

Verification:
- Repro first: demonstrate the failure before the fix (full suite, or the test under induced concurrent load); demonstrate the same procedure green after.
- mix test test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs green.
- Full suite green at least twice post-fix.

Allowed touches: lib/ancora/** (only if the root cause is the product output path), test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs, test/support/**.
Out of scope: weakening the JSON-first-line assertion; unrelated test churn.

Blocks ancora-yzu.15: L13 admission smoke is red on this signature.

Summary: Proved hypothesis (b): the captured child Mix process emitted its own "Waiting for lock on the build directory" bootstrap diagnostic under shared-build contention before Ancora's JSON writer started; no sibling output leaked and the product output layer was not involved. The helper now sets MIX_QUIET=1, which silences Mix diagnostics while preserving direct Ancora stdout, and a regression test fails if that flag is omitted. The unchanged-tree contention repro produced the exact Jason 0x57 failure; after the fix the concurrent 322-test suite and repeated target runs had no JSON failure, with one artificial cross-VM worker later stopping on a separate temp-directory collision.

title: Flaky JSON-mode golden test: warning byte reaches stdout first under full-suite concurrency
